law.catch_line: Prohibition on persons under 21 years of age placing wagers and sports betting on youth sports; penalty

text.section: No person shall wager on or conduct any wagering on the outcome of a game pursuant to the provisions of this chapter unless such person is 21 years of age or older. No person shall accept any wager from a person under age 21.
No person shall wager on or conduct any wagering on the outcome of a youth sports game. No person shall accept any wager from a person on a youth sports game.
Violation of this section is a Class 1 misdemeanor.
